title: Grand Opening Of IUIC Puerto Rico!!
cleanTitle: Grand Opening Of IUIC Puerto Rico!!
segments: All praise to the most high, man. Grand
opening finally has arrived to the head
tribe of the northern kingdom, tribe of
Ephraim. Our school will be opening in
Korasad, Puerto Rico. And all praise to
the most high for the grand opening. We
got Deacon Yosua in the building,
Captain Ze, Captain Abiel, and many more
that are here to continue to support
with the grand opening of IUIC Puerto
Rico. We give all honor and praises to
the most high God. He is our foundation.
Christ is our king. And that's the
reason why we are blessed today is
because we're keeping the commandments.
So now we have opened a spiritual
hospital for our people that need it out
here in Puerto Rico has been fed too
many lies with Catholicism,
Christianity, and what have you. All
manner of uh religions. So all praise be
to the most high God. The Lord saw fit
for us to be able to open this school
here for you in Puerto Rico. Now y'all
have to maintain that blessing. Let this
mind be in you which was also in Christ
Jesus. Let that mind be in you which was
also in Christ Jesus. Esteem each other
better than your own self and make sure
that your fellowship is fellowship of
the spirit. We open up the doors for
IUIC Puerto Rico
Aubrey. Yes.
